items.title: Coop P0: splitscreen design doc v2
items.body: Update docs/roadmap/splitscreen.md: PlayerView model, input ownership (P1 KBM|pad0, P2 pad1), dual camera, shared World, pause rules, save schema, PS5 browser DualSense notes, acceptance checklist.

items.title: Coop P0: PlayerView pure module stub
items.body: Create js/player-view.js with PlayerView class: {id, camera pose, inventory ref, survival ref, inputDevice, viewportRect}. No Three.js coupling beyond plain data. Unit-testable pure helpers for viewport split L/R.

items.title: Coop P0: dual input router module
items.body: Create js/input-coop.js: map gamepad index 0/1 + optional KBM to player slots; poll both pads; expose getMoveLook(playerId). Do not rewrite js/input.js wholesale — thin adapter.

items.title: Coop P0: dual survival state clone
items.body: Create js/coop-state.js helpers to clone/init second player survival meters + inventory from defaults; serialize both players. Pure module + smoke tests.

items.title: Coop P0: viewport math helpers
items.body: Pure functions splitViewport(width,height,mode=lr|tb) → [{x,y,w,h}x2]; letterbox safe for 16:9 TV. tests only.

items.title: Coop P0: title Solo|Local Co-op option
items.body: Title screen: mode toggle Solo / Local Co-op (2P). Persist choice in session. Sync index.html + public/index.html. Wire mode flag into main start path without full game rewrite.

items.title: Coop P0: dual camera setup in game
items.body: When coop mode: two PerspectiveCameras, scissor/viewport render both each frame. Shared world scene. Fallback solo = current path. Surgical game.js only if needed.

items.title: Coop P0: bind P1 KBM and pad0
items.body: P1 accepts keyboard+mouse OR gamepad0 (first connected). Document priority when both present. No crash if zero pads.

items.title: Coop P0: bind P2 pad1 DualSense
items.body: P2 exclusively gamepad index 1 (second DualSense). If missing, show connect-controller prompt half-screen. PS5 browser standard mapping.

items.title: Coop P0: dual HUD half-screen
items.body: Clone critical HUD (health hunger stamina temp hotbar) per viewport. CSS grid or absolute halves. Sync dual HTML.

items.title: Coop P0: shared world block edits
items.body: Both players can mine/place; last-write-wins same cell; no double-drop glitch. Test with simulated two actors if possible.

items.title: Coop P0: dual player entities
items.body: Two player bodies/colliders in world; separate positions; no clipping permanently; independent look rays for mine/place.

items.title: Coop P0: coop save load format
items.body: Save schema vN: players:[{pos,look,inv,survival}]. Load restores both. Solo saves remain valid. Backward compatible.

items.title: Coop P0: coop pause both freeze
items.body: Pause freezes sim for both; either player Options/Esc opens pause; resume clears both.

items.title: Coop P0: coop inventory isolation
items.body: Each player E/Share opens own inventory only; no shared hotbar selection bleed.

items.title: Coop P0: fauna aggro multi-target
items.body: Hostile AI can target nearest of two players; switch target on distance. No null player crash in solo.

items.title: Coop P0: audio listener primary
items.body: AudioListener follows P1 (or louder average later). Document choice in splitscreen.md. No double AudioListener.

items.title: Coop P0: perf budget dual render
items.body: Coop mode reduce chunk radius or shadow quality default; settings flag coopQuality. Keep 30fps floor target on mid PC.

items.title: Coop P0: drop-in second pad
items.body: If solo running and pad1 connects, optional prompt Join Co-op without full restart when safe; else require title restart. Document.

items.title: Coop P0: death rules per player
items.body: One player death does not end session; dead player spectate or respawn timer; both dead → game over overlay.

items.title: Coop P0: crafting station shared use
items.body: Either player can use crafting table; UI binds to acting player inventory.

items.title: Coop P0: chest shared container
items.body: Chests are world-shared; open locks briefly per opener to avoid desync; solo path unchanged.

items.title: Coop P0: sleep bed both required
items.body: Optional rule: both near bed to skip night OR P1 only with consent prompt. Implement one and document.

items.title: Coop P0: smoke tests coop pure
items.body: Add pure tests for viewport split, coop-state serialize, input slot mapping without WebGL.

items.title: Coop P0: help overlay dual controls
items.body: H/help shows P1 KBM + P2 DualSense glyphs. Sync HTML.

items.title: Coop P0: PS5 browser QA checklist doc
items.body: docs/playtest-ps5-browser.md: open GH Pages, two DualSense, TV safe, known browser limits, pass/fail table.

items.title: Coop P0: connect-controller UI
items.body: Half-screen prompt when coop and pad missing; poll until connected; large TV-readable text.

items.title: Coop P0: scissor clear no bleed
items.body: Ensure viewport scissor/clear does not leave trails between halves; skybox both cams.

items.title: Coop P0: pointer lock P1 only
items.body: Pointer lock only for P1 KBM; P2 never needs pointer lock. Esc handling does not break P2 look.

items.title: Coop P0: hotbar select per pad
items.body: D-pad or shoulder cycle hotbar independently per player.

items.title: Platform P0: dual gamepad indices
items.body: Track all connected gamepads; assign stable slot0/slot1 by connection order; handle disconnect mid-game without crash.

items.title: Platform P0: DualSense standard mapping table
items.body: Single source of truth button map for Standard Gamepad; document PS5 browser quirks; smoke assert map keys exist.

items.title: Platform P0: TV safe margins 5pct
items.body: CSS env(safe-area) + 5% padding mode for TV; toggle in settings; dual HTML.

items.title: Platform P0: large HUD text TV
items.body: Scale HUD fonts when tvMode or resolution height>=1080 console-like; readability test checklist.

items.title: Platform P0: gamepad title navigation
items.body: Navigate title Continue/New/Co-op with D-pad + Cross confirm Circle back. No mouse required on PS5 browser.

items.title: Platform P0: gamepad inventory navigation
items.body: Grid focus for inventory slots via D-pad; Cross select; Circle close.

items.title: Platform P0: performance preset Console
items.body: Preset: lower render distance, fewer entities, disable fancy shadows — for PS5 browser GPU.

items.title: Platform P1: vibration mine hit
items.body: Rumble weak on block break / strong on damage if actuator present; try/catch.

items.title: Platform P1: aim assist light place
items.body: Subtle snap for gamepad ray to block face centers within small angle; off by default on KBM.

items.title: Platform P1: rebind UI stub
items.body: Settings page list actions + current button; click/listen to rebind; persist localStorage.
